description: MacBook Pro 14-inch M1 Pro (j314s, t6000) on mx-mac: raw host answers for record mode
source: Real evidence from the M1 Pro, 2026-09-12: reviews/pr-9835/m1-hardware.log and m1-validation.md (uname, model, PCI, Hyprland input devices, Wi-Fi address). No kernel log or device-tree dump of the M1 exists yet; the v0.1 dogfood run records them. The package, encryption, first-boot, mac-check, GPU, battery and CPU answers were never captured on the M1: they are reconstructed from what is known of the install (mx-mac, GRUB, linux-asahi) and noted as such. The inventory answers come from the booted kernel's own package, linux-asahi 7.1.13.asahi1-1 and its headers (device tree, module aliases, build config). The M1 has since moved to the converged image, so its mx-mac answers (packages, encryption, mac-check, GPU tools, speaker services) can no longer be captured and stay reconstructed; tests/corpus/m1-pro-converged is its real run. The camera, function-key and ports answers are stand-ins, noted on each entry, until the next dogfood run records them.
pseudonymized: Committed evidence is pseudonymized: every Wi-Fi network name, MAC address, IP address, UUID, boot id and account name in it was swapped for a fake of the same shape before commit, so the corpus exercises the scrubber on real log formats without publishing the real values. 'forbidden' lists the identifiers (decoys and lab hostnames) that must never survive into a recording or report.

argv:
for p in /sys/class/typec/port*; do
  n=${p##*/port}
  case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
  if [ -e "/sys/class/typec/port$n-partner" ]; then partner=yes; else partner=no; fi
  data=$(sed -n 's/.*\[\(.*\)\].*/\1/p' "$p/data_role" 2>/dev/null)
  power=$(sed -n 's/.*\[\(.*\)\].*/\1/p' "$p/power_role" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "typec $n partner=$partner data=$data power=$power"
done
for d in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*; do
  [ -r "$d/speed" ] || continue
  case ${d##*/} in *:*) continue;; usb*) kind=root;; *) kind=device;; esac
  class=$(cat "$d/bDeviceClass" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$class" = 00 ]; then class=$(cat "$d"/*:*/bInterfaceClass 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi
  echo "usb $kind speed=$(cat "$d/speed") class=$class"
done

argv:
if [ ! -d /sys/bus/thunderbolt/devices ]; then echo nobus; exit 0; fi
for d in /sys/bus/thunderbolt/devices/*; do
  [ -r "$d/uevent" ] || continue
  line="thunderbolt ${d##*/} $(sed -n 's/^DEVTYPE=//p' "$d/uevent")"
  for f in generation rx_speed rx_lanes authorized; do
    if [ -r "$d/$f" ]; then line="$line $f=$(tr -d ' \n' < "$d/$f")"; fi
  done
  echo "$line"
done

argv:
swipe=$(hyprctl getoption gestures:workspace_swipe 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^int: *//p')
[ -n "$swipe" ] && echo "swipe-live $swipe"
field() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | sed -nE "s/.*$2=\"?([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\"?([,;}].*)?$/\1/p"; }
n=0
for f in "$HOME"/.local/share/omarchy/default/hypr/*.lua "$HOME"/.local/share/omarchy/default/hypr/*.conf \
         "$HOME"/.config/hypr/*.lua "$HOME"/.config/hypr/*.conf; do
  [ -r "$f" ] || continue
  n=$((n + 1))
  { sed -e 's/--.*$//' -e 's/#.*$//' "$f" | tr -d ' \t' | tr '\n' ';'; echo; } |
    sed -e 's/^/;/' -e 's/hl\./\nhl./g' -e 's/;gesture=/\ngesture=/g' -e 's/;workspace_swipe=/\nworkspace_swipe=/g' |
    while IFS= read -r c; do
      case $c in
        'hl.gesture({'*)
          c=${c%%\}*}
          [ "$(field "$c" fingers)" = 3 ] || continue
          action=$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | sed -nE 's/.*action="([a-z]+)"([,;].*)?$/\1/p')
          case $action in workspace|unset) ;; *) action=other;; esac
          echo "gesture 3 $(field "$c" direction) $action";;
        'gesture=3,'*)
          c=${c#gesture=}; c=${c%%;*}
          old=$IFS; IFS=,; set -- $c; IFS=$old
          dir=$2; shift 2; action=other
          for a in "$@"; do case $a in *:*) ;; workspace|unset) action=$a; break;; *) break;; esac; done
          echo "gesture 3 $dir $action";;
        'workspace_swipe='*)
          case ${c#workspace_swipe=} in true*|1*|yes*|on*) echo "workspace-swipe 1";; *) echo "workspace-swipe 0";; esac;;
      esac
    done
done
echo "files $n"
commands.note: stand-in: Omarchy's default hypr/input.lua and the user's untouched config/hypr/input.lua (the three-finger workspace swipe commented out), as the script prints them; hyprctl can't reach Hyprland over SSH
